explication: H5-Dooring is a React visual H5 landing-page editor. Users configure pages from component materials, preview the result, and can build forms and manage data sources. The graph preserves documented editor capabilities and component families, while the source excerpts support only some implementation links; dashed, uncited links mark the broader editor workflow where wiring was not shown.
